findings.issue: הַשְּׂרָפִים is a definite common noun, not a proper name; los serafines leaves that lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
Morphology marks בָּעָם as a preposition plus an anarthrous singular noun; el adds definiteness not coded on that token.

notes: Jehová, the plural bite, and singular murió with anarthrous pueblo abundante desde Israel match the remaining tokens.
